title: Portfolio Track Record
text:
Over our 5+ years of building digital products, our team has delivered over 10+ production platforms and applications across diverse industries:
- **Zion**: AI-powered cross-platform mobile application for event discovery, social ticketing, real-time chat, and host analytics built with Flutter, Firebase, and Stripe.
- **Utsav**: Unified mobile mandal and community festival management platform for Ganesh Chaturthi scheduling, donation ledger tracking, expense reporting, and committee workflows built with Flutter and Node.js.
- **FreightFlow**: Enterprise logistics and supply chain orchestration platform featuring real-time fleet dispatch, automated invoicing, and route optimization.
- **SyncServe POS**: High-throughput retail point-of-sale system supporting multi-terminal syncing, barcode scanning, offline caching, and instant GST invoices.
- **MasterWeg**: All-in-one German university admissions platform with AI-driven course matching and automated document preparation.
- **TechSonance Marketplace**: Multi-vendor B2B e-commerce platform with automated merchant payouts, advanced catalog search, and dispute management.
- **AccuNest**: Comprehensive accounting and financial management suite for SMEs.
- **Agraj Enterprise**: Industrial protective coating and structural painting platform with project estimating and lead management.

text: We build software across Logistics & Freight, Retail & POS, Events & Ticketing, Community & Religious Organizations, Education & EdTech, Industrial Services, and B2B E-Commerce.

title: 100% Intellectual Property (IP) Ownership
text: All source code, documentation, UI/UX designs, database schemas, and intellectual property developed during the project belong 100% to the client upon milestone payment completion.

title: Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
text: We prioritize client confidentiality and enter into mutual Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) prior to project discovery and repository access.

title: Post-Launch Warranty & Support
text: Every project delivered by TechSonance comes with a dedicated post-launch warranty period during which all bugs or deviations from the agreed scope are fixed free of charge.

title: Source Code & Account Handover
text: Upon project completion, we transfer all repository access (GitHub/GitLab), cloud environments (AWS/Vercel/Firebase), API keys, and deployment credentials directly to your designated accounts, along with technical setup documentation.

title: Engagement Models
text:
We offer three flexible and transparent engagement structures:
1. **Fixed-Price Milestone Contracts**: Best for projects with clear requirements. Defined scopes, guaranteed delivery dates, and payments tied to approved deliverables.
2. **Monthly Dedicated Teams / Developers**: Best for evolving products and fast iterations. Full-time dedicated engineers (Next.js, Flutter, Node.js, AI) focused exclusively on your backlog.
3. **Time & Material (T&M)**: Best for technical consulting, architecture audits, or rapid prototyping.

title: Factors Influencing Project Cost
text: Costs vary based on platform scope (Web, iOS, Android), feature complexity, third-party integrations (payments, maps, SMS), AI/LLM integration depth, and timeline urgency.

title: Free Initial Consultation & Proposal
text: We offer a 100% free 30-minute discovery consultation. We review your idea and deliver a transparent scope breakdown, architecture suggestion, and cost estimate with zero obligation.

title: Payment Terms & Methods
text: Payments are divided across project milestones (e.g. deposit at kickoff, sprint milestones upon approved demo, and final balance at release). We accept Bank Wire Transfers (NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT), UPI, Wise, PayPal, and Stripe.

title: Six-Stage Development Lifecycle
text:
1. **Discovery & Requirements**: A 30-minute consultation to define core objectives, user personas, MVP feature scope, and tech stack choices.
2. **Architecture & Milestone Plan**: Creation of database schemas, API contracts, milestone deliverables, and fixed-price or sprint estimates.
3. **UI/UX Product Design**: Wireframing and interactive Figma prototypes approved by you before engineering commences.
4. **Agile Sprint Execution**: Bi-weekly sprints with working demo links, continuous integration, and transparent pull requests.
5. **QA & Security Auditing**: Automated unit and integration testing, cross-browser/device validation, and security vulnerability scanning.
6. **Launch & Handover**: Production deployment, full source code and account transfer, training walkthroughs, and warranty support.

title: Communication & Collaboration Tools
text: We communicate actively on Slack, WhatsApp, or Email, paired with weekly live video sprint reviews (Google Meet or Zoom) and real-time task boards on Jira, Trello, or ClickUp.

title: Typical MVP Estimates & Scopes
text:
- **Mobile MVP (iOS & Android with Flutter)**: Cross-platform mobile app with authentication, user profiles, notifications, offline sync, and payment gateway. Typically 6 to 10 weeks.
- **SaaS Platform MVP**: Multi-tenant web platform with authentication, dashboard analytics, role management, and automated subscription billing. Typically 8 to 12 weeks.
- **Custom AI / RAG Chatbot**: Document indexing, vector search, custom system guardrails, natural language query answering, and meeting booking integration. Typically 2 to 4 weeks.
- **B2B E-Commerce Marketplace**: Multi-vendor catalogs, checkout, payment processing, seller dashboard, and shipping integrations. Typically 8 to 12 weeks.
- **Custom POS & Inventory System**: Offline-first point-of-sale, barcode scanning, live multi-terminal sync, and automated GST billing. Typically 6 to 10 weeks.

title: How We Scope New Ideas
text: If you have a rough idea or wireframes, we help distill it into a phased roadmap: Phase 1 (Core MVP to validate with users), Phase 2 (Advanced features and automation), and Phase 3 (Scaling infrastructure).

title: Web Application Development
text: We build responsive web portals, marketing websites, and enterprise web applications using React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js or NestJS backends. Our web solutions prioritize core web vitals, sub-second page loads, and modern SEO architectures.

title: Cross-Platform Mobile App Development
text: We engineer cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using Flutter and Dart from a single unified codebase. Features include offline storage with SQLite/Hive/Isar, smooth 60fps animations, push notifications via FCM/APNs, biometric authentication, and in-app payment gateways.

title: SaaS Product Engineering
text: We design and deploy full-lifecycle SaaS software with multi-tenant database isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), subscription billing via Stripe or Razorpay, automated onboarding, usage telemetry, and microservices on AWS.

title: Custom ERP, CRM & POS Systems
text: We build tailored business operating platforms: multi-location point-of-sale (POS) systems, customer relationship management (CRM) software, enterprise resource planning (ERP), inventory tracking, automated GST billing, and employee management.

title: AI Chatbots & Workflow Automation
text: We design and build production-ready RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) assistants, website chatbots with zero hallucinations, customer service automation, and agentic workflows using OpenAI, Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, and pgvector.

title: DevOps, Cloud & Maintenance
text: We configure cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Vercel, setup Docker containerization, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines, SSL security, database replication, server monitoring, and continuous post-launch maintenance.

title: Engineering Team & Roles
text: We are a focused, senior-led software development team. Our core roles include full-stack web engineers (React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript), mobile app developers (Flutter for iOS & Android), UI/UX product designers, QA automation testers, and DevOps cloud engineers. Our founder remains directly involved in technical architecture and quality reviews for every client engagement.

title: Seniority & Experience
text: Our lead engineers possess over 5+ years of production experience building high-scale architectures, real-time messaging, distributed caching, multi-tenant databases, and AI LLM integrations.

title: In-House Delivery & Dedicated Points of Contact
text: All primary engineering, architecture, design, and DevOps are executed directly in-house without outsourcing core tasks. Every client project is assigned a dedicated technical project manager or engineering lead who provides transparent communication, bi-weekly demos, and sprint progress tracking.

title: Staff Augmentation & Dedicated Developers
text: Clients can hire dedicated full-time or part-time developers (Next.js, Node.js, Flutter) working exclusively on their products under their own sprint cadence and timezone preferences.

Question: How do I book a meeting or consultation?
Alternative phrasings: book a call | schedule meeting | talk to your team | book appointment | book free consultation
Answer: You can book a free consultation right here in our chat! Simply click 'Book Free Consultation' or select a slot that suits your schedule.
